verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a scheduling product could plausibly defend focus time, but the evidence shows no capability that creates recurring focus or habit blocks and automatically reschedules them when conflicts arise. SavvyCal's time budgeting via calendar events, per-day/week/month meeting caps, and fragmentation-reducing suggestions only constrain when others can book. These are adjacent booking controls, not auto-defended, flexibly moved focus time, so they earn no credit.
